title: Purple Hibiscus
author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
summary: Fifteen-year-old Kambili lives in Nigeria with a rich, devout father who is admired in public but violent at home. A stay with her aunt shows her a freer way of living.
readIf: you like quiet, emotional coming-of-age novels with political and family tension.
skipIf: you want to avoid scenes of domestic violence and religious strictness.
